text: {"lessons":["Several months of falling account value and selling at losses remind me not to let short-term fear dictate trades; I should follow a clear plan rather than react to each dip.","Buying more of D and E without a stated thesis or risk limit left me exposed when prices turned; I should size positions carefully and know in advance what would change my view.","Repeated trades have not yet improved my results, so I should avoid unnecessary turnover and compare each trade’s expected benefit with simply holding a diversified portfolio."]}
